Use case: stylized-concept. Create a new two-panel full-body creature concept comparison board by EDITING the supplied approved Yinglong board. Reference is for PAINTING STYLE, presentation, readability, standing posture and typography, not for copying its dragon species. Keep the dark slate-green studio backdrop, fine antique-gold frame and understated serif captions, polished dimensional painterly creature rendering, rich natural scales, cool shadows and warm highlights. Landscape 3:2 composition. Base at LEFT; its upgrade at RIGHT, in equal panels, with full bodies, tails, horns and wingtips completely inside each panel and generous breathing room. Same camera, baseline and roughly matched body pose. Both face RIGHT in three-quarter side view. All FOUR clawed feet bear weight firmly on the ground with clear contact shadows; near forefoot and hindfoot separated and far feet visibly offset. No raised leg or hovering. Natural, proud, relaxed idle stance, neck gently elevated. Each dragon has ONE head, FOUR legs and TWO wings. Graceful muscular anatomy and a clear attractive silhouette, never squat, obese, covered in giant armor plates or coins, no multiple heads. Fold wings partly back in a resting pose, enough membrane visible to assess them. One restrained elemental detail only; no large spell effects. No armor, clothing, human jewelry, necklaces, weapons, saddles, statues, UI stats or scenic distractions. Upgrade must be clearly the same species with developed silhouette and richer anatomy, not simply recolored. These are myth-inspired original GAME ADAPTATIONS, not historical reconstructions. Do not include Yinglong, Chinese antlers, whiskers or a mane.
NEW SPECIES: DDRAIG GOCH-inspired Welsh RED DRAGON. A beautiful classic European dragon, sleek athletic build with long strong limbs, proud swan-curved muscular neck, deep chest but slim waist, long pointed tail curled safely along ground behind it, handsome angular face with long muzzle, intelligent amber eye and two smooth backward-swept ivory horns. Rich ruby-crimson overlapping small scales, warm cream-gold belly plates, broad elegant red membrane wings with burnt-orange translucent inner panels; subtle neat spine fins, no excessive spikes. The silhouette feels noble, powerful and agile, recognizably different from the reference serpentine rain dragon. LEFT BASE: RED DRAGON, clean mature red body, modest paired ivory horns, taut intact wings and restrained warmth inside mouth. RIGHT UPGRADE: CROWNFLAME DRAGON, deeper saturated garnet red scales with bright scarlet highlights and subtle copper edges, refined natural crown of six swept-back ivory-and-gold horns around ONE head, longer flowing flame-shaped dorsal fins, larger graceful wings with amber-gold translucent membrane towards tips, more developed shoulders while retaining slim agile torso, long elegant spearhead tail tip. A tiny ember or two by the jaws and softly glowing throat. NO jagged black lava armor and no damaged wings. More regal, not more monstrous. TITLE at top exactly "DDRAIG GOCH". Left caption exactly "RED DRAGON", small "Base"; right "CROWNFLAME DRAGON", small "Upgrade".

NEW SPECIES: AZHDAHA-inspired original Persian DESERT DRAGON. Emphasize an unusually long horizontal serpentine torso, long gently S-curved neck, four slender strong grounded lizard legs, elegant narrow predatory wedge-shaped head, a pair of long polished crescent horns sweeping backward like an oryx, a small fan-shaped cheek frill, and two distinctive LONG LOW SAIL-LIKE WINGS swept horizontally back over the body rather than towering upward. Scalloped wing edges with graceful long supports; smooth unbroken membranes, not feathers. Long whip tail rests in a loose curve on the sand-colored stone floor behind the legs. Body has fine warm sandstone and pale honey scales, ivory ventral plates, restrained dark-teal scale markings forming natural interlocking geometric patterns, bright turquoise eyes. Base is athletic, elegant, almost feline in stance, not bulky, no bearded/chinese dragon elements. LEFT BASE: DUNE DRAGON, pale sandy ochre and ivory, slender swept horns, copper-tan sail wing membranes with subtle turquoise margins. RIGHT UPGRADE: SUNVEIL DRAGON, same recognizably elongated desert dragon anatomy and grounded posture, more pronounced graceful neck frill, longer backward-curving ivory crescent horns, richer cream-gold armorless scale mosaic with deep lapis-blue patterning down neck and flanks, long pearlescent amber wings lined with refined blue-gold natural markings, a double ridge of delicate fin-like crests along tail. Larger, more sophisticated wing silhouette and crown-frill outline distinguish upgrade at thumbnail size. Only a few drifting sand grains by the tail, no magical glow obscuring feet. Overall look: ancient desert elegance, sunlit mineral color, taut lean proportions, gold and lapis accents that are natural scales NOT fitted jewelry. TITLE exactly "AZHDAHA". Left caption "DUNE DRAGON", small "Base"; right "SUNVEIL DRAGON", small "Upgrade".
